title: Explore shows the whole market, ordered hood, town, market, online, with towns by adjacency

criteria.text: Every locality-scoped surface (Explore, Home, search, unclaimed, report queue) shows one market: the vantage's, the member's home by default
criteria.note: Scoping is by metro (`resolveFeedMetro` falls back to Sacramento, `src/lib/feed/feed-metro.ts`); search covers 'the whole market' in #924's words but reads the metro scope [V]. No market scope on any surface. #932's rings start from the member's home town (`explore_vantage`), inside the metro. Open #696, deferred to the fortnight after beta.

criteria.text: Inside the market: hood, town, towns by adjacency, rest of the market, online last; county remainder counts as a town; bridge table
criteria.note: No adjacency table, no `ST_Touches`, no bridge table, no town or hood band in the repo [V grep]. What exists instead is #932 (Don, 2026-10-18 [for now, beta]): rings of about 15 minutes' drive as straight-line kilometres from the home town's centroid, widened until a screen is full, capped at an hour; order inside is recency and `mixRuns` (#902). Open #697.

criteria.text: Locality on a card, a Page or any surface but Explore's reach line is a neighbourhood or town name: no miles, minutes, hop count or 'near you'
criteria.note: Explore cards show no distance [V `BrowseResultCard.tsx`], but distance still shows elsewhere: `venueDistanceMeters` on the place pages `/p/[...slug]`, 'No matches near you yet.' in `FeedEmptyState.tsx`, 'near you' in the site description (`layout.tsx`) and landing copy; `MarketSelector.tsx` still prints miles but nothing imports it [V grep]. No guard scans for them (#697's checklist). Open #697.

criteria.text: Explore's reach line and the How far filter say nothing in minutes; no drive-time rings
criteria.note: Retired: Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #796 and #922, built in #932, 'supersedes, for Explore's reach line only, F104 criterion 3 and its Not this line': the top-of-page line may say minutes ('Within 15 minutes of you · Show more nearby') and the filter sheet's How far group sets the ring (15 / 30 / 45 / 60 / Whole area); cards still show no miles or minutes [V #796 comment, #932 body]. The ruling asks socialus-plan to amend F104; `sync-roadmap` does that. Shown, not counted.

criteria.text: A Page's market is its anchor Location's, else its owner's home market; a Page in a waiting market is absent until it opens
criteria.note: No Page-to-market link or waiting-market filter in the repo [V grep]; a Page's `where_mode` (#944) and anchor decide its pin, not its market. Open #696.

criteria.text: A member with no neighbourhood starts at the town band; the hood band exists and is empty
criteria.note: No bands exist [V grep]; #932 starts a member at their home town's ring, which is the nearest thing to the town band and is not it. Open #697.
